title: Machine Learning Engineer
job_description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to develop and evaluate machine learning solutions for real-world problems. The candidate will work with data science and engineering teams to build predictive models and NLP-based applications.

Responsibilities:
- Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models.
- Clean, process, and analyze structured datasets.
- Build and improve NLP-based solutions.
- Work with data science libraries for numerical and data analysis.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate machine learning solutions.

Requirements:
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Experience with Pandas and NumPy.
- Experience with Scikit-learn.
- Good understanding of machine learning concepts.
- Working knowledge of SQL.
- Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP).

title: Backend Developer
job_description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer to design, develop, and maintain reliable server-side applications. The candidate will work on backend services, APIs, and database-driven applications while collaborating with frontend and engineering teams.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain backend services and applications.
- Design and implement REST API services.
- Build applications using Java and Spring Boot.
- Work with relational databases and write efficient queries.
- Troubleshoot backend issues and improve application reliability.

Requirements:
- Strong Java programming skills.
- Experience with Spring Boot.
- Experience developing REST APIs.
- Working knowledge of MySQL.
- Understanding of backend application development and database systems.

title: Data Analyst
job_description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst to transform raw data into meaningful insights that support business and technical decision-making. The candidate will analyze datasets, prepare reports, and communicate findings to stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
- Collect, clean, and analyze structured datasets.
- Perform statistical analysis and identify meaningful trends.
- Prepare reports and analytical summaries.
- Use spreadsheets and data analysis tools to support decision-making.
- Work with technical and business teams to communicate data-driven insights.

Requirements:
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Experience with Pandas and NumPy.
- Working knowledge of SQL.
- Experience with Excel.
- Understanding of data analysis and statistics.

title: Frontend Developer
job_description:
We are looking for a Frontend Developer to build responsive and interactive web interfaces. The candidate will work closely with designers, backend developers, and other engineers to create reliable and user-friendly web applications.

Responsibilities:
- Develop responsive and interactive web interfaces.
- Build reusable frontend components.
- Develop applications using JavaScript and React.
- Work with TypeScript for maintainable frontend code.
- Implement web pages using HTML and CSS.
- Collaborate with backend and design teams.

Requirements:
- Strong JavaScript programming skills.
- Experience with React.
- Experience with TypeScript.
- Good knowledge of HTML and CSS.

title: Backend Python Developer
job_description:
We are looking for a Backend Python Developer to build and maintain scalable web applications and backend services. The candidate will develop APIs, work with databases, and collaborate with other engineers to deliver reliable software.

Responsibilities:
- Develop backend applications using Python and Django.
- Design and maintain REST API services.
- Work with PostgreSQL databases.
- Use Git for source control and collaborative development.
- Troubleshoot application issues and improve backend reliability.

Requirements:
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Experience with Django.
- Experience developing REST APIs.
- Working knowledge of PostgreSQL.
- Experience using Git.
